race.comment: READY AS BAM (6) has the clearest race form after consecutive seconds, the latest a neck defeat to Happyaziam at Toowoomba. He has also placed at around this trip before, so the profile is solid for a maiden of this depth. Should go close. BOLD GEM (11) was third on debut at this track on soft ground and gets barrier 2 with scope to sharpen second-up. Can feature. PINOT PIRATE (5) is a $95,000 Pierata gelding from the Chris & Corey Munce stable, with the trainer profile and purchase price giving him genuine debut appeal. Watch for any market moves. STELLIQUE (10) is a filly by Jungle Cat out of La Mia Stella who is at the races for the first time today. Fitter for a recent trial win. A betting push will add to the confidence.
